scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run test:seo && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/compress.mjs
scripts.build:android: npm run build && node scripts/slim-android.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:android:prod: node scripts/patch-plugins.mjs && node scripts/copy-ocr.mjs && tsc && vite build --mode android && node scripts/slim-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.templates: esbuild scripts/make-templates.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.make-templates.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.make-templates.cjs; rm -f scripts/.make-templates.cjs
scripts.invoices:examples: esbuild scripts/make-invoice-pdfs.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=scripts/.make-invoice-pdfs.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.make-invoice-pdfs.cjs; rm -f scripts/.make-invoice-pdfs.cjs
scripts.taxforms:verify: esbuild scripts/taxforms/verify-forms.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pdfjs-dist --outfile=scripts/.verify-forms.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.verify-forms.cjs; status=$?; rm -f scripts/.verify-forms.cjs; exit $status
scripts.invoices:verify: esbuild scripts/verify-invoice-pdfs.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pdfjs-dist --outfile=scripts/.verify-invoice-pdfs.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.verify-invoice-pdfs.cjs; status=$?; rm -f scripts/.verify-invoice-pdfs.cjs; exit $status
scripts.ejemplo-binance: esbuild scripts/ejemplo-binance.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:pdfjs-dist --outfile=scripts/.ejemplo-binance.cjs --log-level=warning && node scripts/.ejemplo-binance.cjs; rm -f scripts/.ejemplo-binance.cjs
